description: Ask the pricing analyst one question about your workspace's pricing, in plain words, and get short claims that each cite the findings or estimates they rest on: every number is checked against them, and a claim with a number that is not is dropped. It refuses to forecast, to state a price or to answer from anything but your own records. At most 500 characters and 30 questions an hour. Paid like the brief (your own model key, the monthly allowance, or your balance if you opted in, which only a credential with routing write or billing write may spend); when nothing pays, the answer lists the closest findings plus the x402 price and requirements for one written answer (0.02 USDC): sign them and call again with payment, which is settled only when a written answer is delivered within this call, never for a refusal. Changes no setting and no price. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

payment.description: Optional. The signed x402 payment, base64, as sent in an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Omit it to read what the call costs and how to pay; nothing is charged until you send it.

question.description: The question, such as "Why is learning not using my estimate yet?". Treated as data, never as instructions.

name: ask_pricing_analyst
